old: [Scope and exact algebra certificate] The only group restriction above is injectivity of both coordinate projections. In particular it includes balanced odd quaternionic isogenies with kernel $\{(-bP,P):P\in E[d]\}$ and $b^\dagger b=d-1$. The exact program \path{agents/monodromy/code/ss_uniform_collision_identities.py} checks the homogeneous coefficient matrix, its determinant, the plane-cubic determinant, the two flex limiting equations and the order-three elliptic translation coefficient.
